                                               Abstract
    In this merged paper, we consider the problem of minimizing a convex function with Lipschitz-
    continuous p-th order derivatives. Given an oracle which when queried at a point returns the first
    p-derivatives of the function
                                 atthat point we provide some methods which compute an ε approxi-
                                2
    mate minimizer in O ε− 3p+1 iterations. These methods match known lower bounds up to poly-
    logarithmic factors for constant p.
